notes: Laboratory forced-flow water vaporizer plus engineering-model multipropellant resistojet; measured over a narrow operating range. Abstract reports 154 × 10^-6 kg/s and 6.8 MJ/kg combined vaporizer/thruster specific power. Table II row-label alignment places 234 in the final test-condition column, which reports 1,043 W total power and 6.86 MJ/kg total specific power.

Current row range is 150–220 s with center 190 s, all described as estimates for higher-power designs; one flight AQUARIUS result is separately reported at about 90 s and under 14 W. The 234 s laboratory result is not a flight result and is configuration-specific.
